mainProjects.title: Ceiling Rail Delivery System
mainProjects.description: Ceiling Rail Delivery System is an automated food delivery system that uses a ceiling-mounted track to deliver items based on table coordinates received from a website, with live position updates and web-based ESP and rover management.

mainProjects.title: Blink Board
mainProjects.description: Blink Board is an assistive app for people with paralysis that uses eye blink detection to select automatically highlighted keys on a virtual keyboard, enabling hands-free communication.

mainProjects.title: Obstacle Avoiding Robot
mainProjects.description: An autonomous robot that detects and avoids obstacles using Arduino Uno and ultrasonic sensors.

mainProjects.title: Calorie Meter
mainProjects.description: A Flask-based web app that estimates calories based on user input.

mainProjects.title: To-Do List
mainProjects.description: A simple task management app with Flask backend and clean UI.

funProjects.title: Redlight Greenlight
funProjects.description: Red Light Green Light is a head motion-controlled game built with Godot and OpenCV, where players move by tilting their head and are eliminated if they move during red light.
